title: River Life Operating System Product Foundation

product.name: The River Life Operating System
product.positioning: A practical system for building a life around what matters most.
product.intendedOutcome: Help a person examine the life they have inherited and built, identify what matters most, evaluate where their time, attention, responsibilities, relationships, work, money, habits, and ambitions are actually carrying them, and leave with a smaller set of deliberate priorities and next actions.

sourceAuthority.principle: The product must be distilled from River Young's existing published body of work and repository authority rather than fabricated as generic self-help material.

architecture.title: Headwaters
architecture.purpose: Examine where the reader has come from, what has shaped them, what should be learned from the past, what requires repair, and what no longer needs to be carried forward.

architecture.title: The Source
architecture.purpose: Clarify identity, beliefs, values, desires, service, purpose, enough, and the kind of person the reader wants to become.

architecture.title: Tributaries
architecture.purpose: Examine the major streams carrying the reader's life, including faith, family, relationships, community, work, money, responsibility, leadership, home, and service.

architecture.title: The Current
architecture.purpose: Evaluate how the reader is actually living now through ordinary days, repeated behavior, time, attention, money, commitments, pace, margin, environment, responsibilities, and contradictions between stated and lived priorities.

architecture.title: The Destination
architecture.purpose: Translate reflection into direction by deciding what deserves protection, what should be refused or released, what costs are worth paying, what responsibilities belong, and what the next right steps are.

requiredCapabilities: clear distinction between free River content and paid structured application

commerceState.note: Existing commerce components are primitives only and must not be interpreted as production-ready product commerce.

implementationSequence: PRODUCT-001A — curriculum and source provenance map
PRODUCT-001B — exercise system and workbook structure
PRODUCT-001C — River Life Operating System v1 content artifact
PRODUCT-001D — digital delivery and fulfillment foundation
PRODUCT-001F — product presentation and public launch path
completionCriteria: Five-part product architecture is represented in a source-grounded curriculum map.
At least twelve substantive exercises are defined and tied to the product curriculum.
Material derived from existing River work preserves identifiable source provenance.
Paid product value is based on structured application and guided execution rather than merely republishing free essays.
A complete v1 digital product artifact exists.
Digital fulfillment exists before public availability is claimed.
Commerce exists before a public price or purchase path is activated.
No unsupported professional, therapeutic, financial, legal, medical, coaching, customer-result, audience, or testimonial claims are introduced.
Repository validation passes for every implementation slice before publication.
